result.sentence: This period comes to $115.00 on this tariff.

work.method: Check the periods first (overlaps, duplicates, periods over 45 days, a month that reads like an extra digit, negative kWh). Then price each period on the tariff: the fixed charge, each tier's kWh at its rate, and the minimum bill, in exact micro-dollars rounded to the cent line by line. A period that crosses a season splits its kWh and tier allowances by days. Time-of-use bills are priced from the kWh in each period as the bill prints them.
steps: March 1 to March 30, 2026 (30 days, 800 kWh): fixed $10.00; all year tier 1, 500 kWh × 12¢ = $60.00; all year tier 2, 300 kWh × 15¢ = $45.00. Total $115.00.
Effective price: $115.00 ÷ 800 kWh = 14.38¢ per kWh, from the computed bills.
assumptions: The tariff is the one in force for the whole period; a rate change within a period is treated like a season change only when it is entered as one.
A tier allowance stated per day is multiplied by the days in the period.
The effective price uses the amounts paid when every period has one, otherwise the computed bills.
